title: Add Target ROI Comparison panel to Strategy Simulation tab
commands_run: python explicit py_compile with temporary cfile for app/V2/ui/strategy_simulation_tab.py core/streamlit_services/strategy_simulation_service.py scripts/test_strategy_simulation_ui.py
python inline sample comparison for simulate_target_roi_comparison

ui_panel.location: Strategy Simulation tab, below Execution Policy Comparison
charts: target ROI vs open lots count

interpretation.lower_roi_behavior: Lower ROI target harvests sooner and can create more frequent close opportunities depending on path.
interpretation.higher_roi_behavior: Higher ROI target waits longer and can accumulate more lots/blocked periods in some paths.
interpretation.execution_assumption_effect: post-only can produce no-fill/open events; taker LIMIT fills marketable close signals; MARKET fallback remains simulation-only.

summary: Strategy Simulation now includes a read-only Target ROI Comparison panel for comparing target ROI thresholds such as 100/150/200/250 across synthetic paths and execution assumptions. It returns PnL, lots, signal, blocked, exposure, no-fill/fill, drawdown, charts, and raw expanders without live, queue, DB, or execution path changes.
